title: French farmer meets an NHI holding a tray of soil samples

tellings.quote: there's this great case in France where a you know a very trusted respected farmer discovers a a spaceship on his land and then he goes up to it and then there's supposedly an nhi there holding a tray full of of soil samples

plain: In France, the story goes, a trusted and respected farmer found a spaceship on his land, walked up to it, and found a non-human intelligence, meaning a being that is not human, standing there holding a tray full of soil samples. The journalist Michael Shellenberger tells it as a case he credits to the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée. If true, it would mean the visitors were collecting samples of the Earth.
